dedupe_keys.name: building data lite indoor environment dataset from three single family houses in virginia

description: This dataset holds indoor environmental measurements from ten low-cost sensing devices installed at different locations in three single-family houses in Virginia, USA, recorded once a minute for a year, giving over 2.5 million records. The devices are Raspberry Pi based Enviro and Enviro+ boards of the Building Data Lite (BDL) sensing system; each record has 12 attributes for Enviro boards or 15 for Enviro+ boards: identifiers and timestamps, proximity and light (LTR-559), humidity, air pressure and temperature (BME280), high, mid and low sound levels and amplitude from a MEMS microphone, and, on Enviro+ boards, oxidised, reduced and ammonia gas resistances (MICS6814). The paper gives the floor plans with sensor placements so that building performance models can be built. Coverage: three houses in Virginia. Access: free on GitHub with metadata and Python validation notebooks; the README also points to building-data-lite.com. Licence: none is stated for the data; the 2025 Data article describing it is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: few homes, low-cost uncalibrated sensors, and gas readings are resistances, not concentrations. Simulation uses: calibrating indoor temperature and humidity models, occupant behaviour inference and sensor placement studies for home digital twins. Related records: flEECe and the Crete building IoT dataset.
